decisions.reason: As a very recent launch with its own webpage in a large German high-tech firm’s space portfolio, it reflects visible investment and public commitment that management is likely to continue backing.
Its dedicated webpage and close fit with the firm’s stated space-navigation offering make management likely to justify and extend the commitment rather than withdraw it after only about a year.

Because it was launched recently and presented as a standalone offering in a strategic adjacent space segment, management is likely to attribute any early weakness to normal market-development delays and keep it.

Although it appears less prominently on the website and therefore carries weaker public commitment than the others, its recent launch and fit with the firm’s broader space-sensor direction still make near-term withdrawal less likely than continuation.
